curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When an aggressive mining outfit moves to seize a vulnerable community's land, who is the mysterious man of the cloth willing to fight back?
curatedMovie.description: A mysterious preacher defends a humble village of prospectors when a mining company moves to take its land.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, measured, and engaging, offering classic frontier drama with clear, exciting stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Eastwood delivers a classic, suspenseful Western drama built on archetypal frontier conflict, steady tension, and the satisfying presence of an enigmatic defender.
